name: mirage
text: Novig prices are slow because Novig has refused the engine's read-only key since about 02:37 UTC. Its answer is 'Novig doesn't know that key ID' (401). At 01:17 the engine read 16 prices a second with that key. Now it has dropped to the public routes, which gave 0.4 a second in the last scan: 246 prices in 637 s, with 13,238 left unread. The address is fine (no refusal, 0 handovers). Because the prices are old, the engine's trader says 'no Novig price read in the last 3 minutes' on 17 to 25 of its candidates per pass and orders very little (0 to 1 per pass). Fix, since the keys are yours: in the app, go to Settings > Cloud scan and tap 'Send a Novig read-only key'. That makes a new read-only key from your management key and sends it to GitHub, replacing the refused one. If you made new Novig keys around 02:30 UTC, the old read key may have been revoked then. The engine picks up the new key at its next restart. Send it and tell me, and I'll check the engine is back to a fast read.
